hooks.name: transform-language-sync
hooks.description: When the transformation engine changes, check that the language document, validator and tests changed with it.

action.prompt: A file in backend/revenant/transform was saved. Check whether the change adds or alters a rule operation or path behaviour. If so, confirm docs/transformation-language.md, the static validator and the unit/property tests reflect it, and list anything that is out of sync. Do not add expression evaluation or code execution.

hooks.name: legacy-client-frozen
hooks.description: The demonstration's legacy client must never be modified after it is written.

action.prompt: A file under demo/legacy-client was saved. This client must remain unchanged so the demonstration is honest. If demo/legacy-client/SHA256 already exists and no longer matches the client source, warn the user clearly and recommend reverting the change.
